Class Perks

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Perks
public final class Perks extends Object
Rank perks: bonuses for players who have a perk's permission. The admin defines the perks in /tempest, Rank perks tab (name, permission, bonuses); a ranks plugin (LuckPerms, or Hytale's own permissions) gives the permission to a rank. A player with several perks gets the best value of each bonus. 
long price = Perks.discounted(uuid, Perks.Bonus.SHOP_DISCOUNT, basePrice);
long reward = Perks.boosted(uuid, Perks.Bonus.QUEST_REWARD, baseReward);
Perks are checked through the player's permissions, so they apply while the player is online.
